name: Agentic BAIM–LLM Evaluation (ABLE)
description: ABLE is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to use biological AI models (BAIMs) in protein design workflows, assessing capabilities such as protein structure retrieval, sequence variant generation, and validation using tools like ProteinMPNN and AlphaFold3.
reputation: A very new, niche benchmark with limited public adoption so far, mainly of interest to researchers studying tool-using LLMs for protein design workflows.
notes: Focuses on dual-use protein engineering workflows; evaluates safety behaviors and task performance; implemented in the Inspect AI framework with natural language prompts and automated scoring.
